mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_points_log (tenant_id, change_type, change_amount, balance_after, source, biz_id, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{changeType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{source}, #{bizId}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_points_log WHERE biz_id = #{bizId} AND change_type = 'charge'
